# Effects, transitions, generators, templates, styles

The built-in catalog (every entry is a plugin-API definition in `src/builtin/`; plugins add more). `mgl docs <name>` prints one.

## Effects

`fx` on a clip is an ordered list: `mgl edit video.mgl.json fx.add shot1 type=blur radius=8`; address a parameter as
`fx.blur.radius` (first of that type) or `fx.0.radius`. Numeric parameters accept keyframes. Stage `source` runs in ffmpeg while
decoding (media clips only; video only); `layer` runs in Skia on the rendered layer; `audio` runs in ffmpeg on the clip's sound, or on a
bus mix when added to a bus (`fx.add bus=dialogue type=...`). An effect with only `audio` is an audio effect.

- **blur** (layer): Gaussian blur of the layer (radius in px).  
  `radius?` number = `10`; `edges?` "extend"\|"transparent" = `"extend"` · extend repeats edge pixels so full-frame video keeps solid borders; transparent lets the blur spread past the layer box
- **glow** (layer): Soft light around the bright parts of the layer (screen-blended blur on top of it).  
  `radius?` number = `20`; `strength?` number = `1`; `threshold?` number = `0` · only pixels brighter than this (0..1 luma) glow; `color?` string · tint the glow with this colour (default: the layer's own colours)
- **shadow** (layer): Drop shadow behind the layer, offset by x/y px and softened by blur px.  
  `x?` number = `8`; `y?` number = `8`; `blur?` number = `16`; `color?` string = `"#000000"`; `opacity?` number = `0.6`
- **vignette** (layer): Darkens (or tints) the layer towards its corners with an elliptical falloff.  
  `amount?` number = `0.5` · opacity of the colour at the corners; `softness?` number = `0.5` · 0 = hard edge near the corners, 1 = falloff from the centre; `color?` string = `"#000000"`
- **chroma-key** (layer): Makes pixels close to the key colour transparent (green/blue screen) and removes colour spill.  
  `color?` string = `"#00ff00"`; `tolerance?` number = `0.3` · chroma distance keyed fully transparent; `softness?` number = `0.1` · chroma distance over which alpha ramps back to opaque; `spill?` number = `1` · how much key-colour spill to remove from kept pixels (1 = cap the key channel at the other two)
- **color** (source + layer): Colour correction: brightness, contrast, saturation, hue rotation, temperature and tint.  
  `brightness?` number = `0`; `contrast?` number = `1`; `saturation?` number = `1`; `hue?` number = `0` · hue rotation in degrees; `temperature?` number = `0` · -1 cool (blue) .. 1 warm (orange); `tint?` number = `0` · -1 green .. 1 magenta
- **lut** (source): Applies a 3D colour lookup table (.cube) to a media clip while it is decoded.  
  `file` string · path to the LUT, relative to the project file; `interp?` "nearest"\|"trilinear"\|"tetrahedral" = `"tetrahedral"`
- **denoise** (source + layer): Reduces video noise on media clips (ffmpeg hqdn3d); other layers get a light smoothing blur.  
  `strength?` number = `0.5`
- **sharpen** (source + layer): Sharpens detail with an unsharp mask (ffmpeg unsharp on media; the same maths on other layers).  
  `amount?` number = `0.8`
- **grain** (layer): Film grain: seeded random noise that changes every frame (deterministic for a seed and frame).  
  `amount?` number = `0.15`; `size?` int = `1` · grain size in px; `mono?` boolean = `true` · same noise on all channels (false = coloured grain); `seed?` int = `0`
- **pixelate** (layer): Mosaic: averages the layer into square blocks of size px.  
  `size?` number = `16`
- **stroke** (layer): Outline around the layer's visible shape (its alpha), width px outside the edge.  
  `width?` number = `4`; `color?` string = `"#ffffff"`; `opacity?` number = `1`
- **mirror** (layer): Flips the layer (flip), or reflects its first half onto the second (reflect), along an axis.  
  `axis?` "horizontal"\|"vertical"\|"both" = `"horizontal"` · horizontal swaps left and right; vertical swaps top and bottom; `mode?` "flip"\|"reflect" = `"flip"`
- **invert** (layer): Inverts the layer's colours (amount 1 = full negative), keeping its alpha.  
  `amount?` number = `1`
- **rgb-split** (layer): Chromatic aberration: shifts the red channel one way and blue the other by amount px.  
  `amount?` number = `6`; `angle?` number = `0` · direction of the red shift in degrees (0 = right)
- **letterbox** (layer): Aspect-ratio matte: bars that show the layer (or, on an adjustment layer, everything below) at `ratio` (2.39, 1.85, 4/3 = 1.333; a ratio narrower than the frame gives side bars).  
  `ratio?` number = `2.39` · visible width / height; `color?` string = `"#000000"`; `opacity?` number = `1`
- **legalize** (layer): Broadcast-safe levels: keeps luma within black..white (16–235) and chroma within 16..chroma (240) in the delivered video (mode=clamp clips only illegal pixels, mode=limit compresses the whole range; set range=pc for full-range deliveries, or raise black / lower white for a safety margin with the default tv-range encode).  
  `mode?` "clamp"\|"limit" = `"clamp"`; `range?` "tv"\|"pc" = `"tv"` · the colour range of the delivery (render colorRange; tv is the default); `black?` number = `16` · lowest legal 8-bit luma code; `white?` number = `235` · highest legal 8-bit luma code; `chroma?` number = `240` · highest legal 8-bit chroma code (lowest = 256 - chroma)
- **highpass** (audio): Audio: cuts rumble and low-frequency noise below `freq` Hz (ffmpeg highpass; 80–100 for voice).  
  `freq?` number = `80` · cutoff in Hz; `poles?` 1\|2 = `2` · 1 = gentle 6 dB/oct, 2 = 12 dB/oct
- **lowpass** (audio): Audio: cuts hiss and highs above `freq` Hz (ffmpeg lowpass; 3000 sounds like a phone, 800 like through a wall).  
  `freq?` number = `12000` · cutoff in Hz; `poles?` 1\|2 = `2` · 1 = gentle 6 dB/oct, 2 = 12 dB/oct
- **eq** (audio): Audio: equaliser with low/high shelves and a mid band in dB (low=-3 mid=2 high=3) plus any number of peaking `bands` [{freq, gain, q}] (0 dB bands are skipped).  
  `low?` number = `0` · low shelf gain in dB; `lowFreq?` number = `120` · low shelf corner in Hz; `mid?` number = `0` · mid band gain in dB; `midFreq?` number = `1000` · mid band centre in Hz; `midQ?` number = `1` · mid band Q; `high?` number = `0` · high shelf gain in dB; `highFreq?` number = `8000` · high shelf corner in Hz; `bands?` object[] = `[]` · extra peaking bands: [{"freq": 3000, "gain": 2, "q": 1.5}]
- **dehum** (audio): Audio: removes mains hum with narrow notches at `freq` (50 Hz Europe/Asia, 60 Hz Americas) and its harmonics.  
  `freq?` 50\|60 = `50` · mains frequency: 50 or 60; `harmonics?` int = `4` · how many notches (freq, 2×freq, ...); `q?` number = `10` · notch Q (higher = narrower, removes less of the voice)
- **denoise-audio** (audio): Audio: broadband noise reduction (hiss, air conditioning, room tone) with ffmpeg afftdn, which tracks the noise floor (for video noise use `denoise`).  
  `amount?` number = `0.5` · 0 = off, 0.5 ≈ 18 dB reduction, 1 = 30 dB (may sound watery); `floor?` number = `-50` · starting noise floor estimate in dBFS
- **compressor** (audio): Audio: evens out loud and quiet passages (ffmpeg acompressor; levels in dB, times in ms, `makeup` adds gain after compression).  
  `threshold?` number = `-18` · level in dBFS above which the sound is compressed; `ratio?` number = `3` · compression ratio (3 = 3:1); `attack?` number = `20` · attack in ms; `release?` number = `250` · release in ms; `makeup?` number = `0` · gain after compression in dB; `knee?` number = `2.8` · knee width (1 = hard, 8 = soft)
- **limiter** (audio): Audio: brickwall limiter that keeps peaks under `ceiling` dBFS (ffmpeg alimiter; the level is not raised), best put last.  
  `ceiling?` number = `-1` · maximum peak level in dBFS; `attack?` number = `5` · attack in ms; `release?` number = `50` · release in ms
- **gate** (audio): Audio: noise gate that turns the sound down while it is under `threshold` dBFS (between phrases), by `range` dB.  
  `threshold?` number = `-40` · level in dBFS under which the gate closes; `range?` number = `-24` · how far the closed gate turns the sound down, in dB; `ratio?` number = `4` · expansion ratio; `attack?` number = `10` · attack in ms; `release?` number = `250` · release in ms
- **deesser** (audio): Audio: softens harsh "s" and "sh" sounds in speech (ffmpeg deesser).  
  `amount?` number = `0.5` · intensity 0..1; `freq?` number = `0.5` · which highs to treat, 0 = lower, 1 = only the very top
- **voice** (audio): Audio: one-step dialogue clean-up preset: high-pass (rumble), gentle compression and de-essing (add dehum / denoise-audio before it when needed).  
  `highpass?` number = `80` · high-pass cutoff in Hz; `compress?` number = `0.5` · 0 = no compression, 1 = strong (ratio 4:1, threshold -26 dB); `deess?` number = `0.4` · de-esser intensity 0..1
- **reverb** (audio): Audio: a simple room ambience from early reflections (ffmpeg aecho): `room` sets the size, `mix` how much is heard.  
  `room?` number = `0.4` · 0 = small room, 1 = hall; `mix?` number = `0.25` · wet level 0..1

## Transitions

A transition is the incoming clip's `in` (centred on the cut): `mgl edit video.mgl.json transition.set shot2 type=wipe len=0.5s`.

- **crossfade**: Dissolves the outgoing clip into the incoming one.
- **dip**: Fades the outgoing clip to a colour (black by default), then the colour to the incoming clip.  
  `color?` string = `"black"` · black, white or any CSS colour such as #1a1a1a
- **wipe**: A moving edge reveals the incoming clip; direction is where the edge travels.  
  `direction?` "left"\|"right"\|"up"\|"down" = `"left"`; `softness?` number = `0` · width of the soft edge as a fraction of the frame
- **slide**: The incoming clip slides in over the outgoing one, moving in the given direction.  
  `direction?` "left"\|"right"\|"up"\|"down" = `"left"`
- **push**: The incoming clip pushes the outgoing one out of frame, both moving in the given direction.  
  `direction?` "left"\|"right"\|"up"\|"down" = `"left"`
- **zoom**: Zooms into the outgoing clip while the incoming one settles from zoomed-in to normal, dissolving between them.  
  `scale?` number = `1.5` · zoom factor at the cut
- **blur**: Blurs the outgoing clip, dissolves at peak blur, and unblurs the incoming clip.  
  `radius?` number = `30` · blur radius in px at the cut
- **spin**: The outgoing clip spins and shrinks away while the incoming clip spins and grows in.  
  `turns?` number = `1` · total turns over the transition (negative = counter-clockwise)
- **flash**: A bright flash of colour (white by default) that peaks at the cut.  
  `color?` string = `"white"`
- **whip**: Whip pan: both clips fly in the given direction like a fast camera pan, smeared by motion blur that peaks at the cut (e.g. transition.set shot-2 type=whip len=0.4s direction=left; 0.3–0.5 s reads best).  
  `direction?` "left"\|"right"\|"up"\|"down" = `"left"` · where the picture moves; `blur?` number = `1` · motion blur strength (1 = a smear of about 15% of the frame at the cut)
- **zoom-punch**: Punch cut: the outgoing clip rushes into the centre with a zoom blur, hard-cuts on a short flash, and the incoming clip punches out from zoomed-in to rest (e.g. transition.set shot-2 type=zoom-punch len=0.35s; 0.25–0.5 s, made for beat-synced cuts).  
  `scale?` number = `1.6` · zoom factor at the cut; `blur?` number = `0.6` · zoom blur strength (0 = sharp); `flash?` number = `0.35` · brightness of the white flash at the cut (0 = none)

## Generators

Clips that draw: `{"gen": {"type": "gradient", "colors": ["#000", "#333"]}}`.

- **gradient**: Linear or radial colour gradient background, optionally rotating over time.  
  `colors?` string[] = `["#1e3c72","#2a5298"]` · two or more colours, evenly spaced; `angle?` number = `90` · direction of a linear gradient in degrees (0 = left to right, 90 = top to bottom); `shape?` "linear"\|"radial" = `"linear"` · linear, or radial from the centre (a clip sets it as gen.shape; gen.type is the generator id); `animate?` number = `0` · degrees per second: rotates a linear gradient, orbits a radial one
- **noise**: Animated smooth noise field (clouds, smoke, grain-field backgrounds) mapped onto a colour ramp.  
  `scale?` number = `160` · feature size in px; `speed?` number = `0.5` · how fast the field evolves (cycles per second); `seed?` int = `0`; `octaves?` int = `3`; `colors?` string[] = `["#000000","#ffffff"]`
- **particles**: Deterministic drifting particles (dust, snow, bubbles, embers) that wrap around the frame.  
  `count?` int = `80`; `color?` string = `"#ffffff"`; `size?` number = `6` · particle diameter in px; `speed?` number = `120` · px per second; `direction?` "left"\|"right"\|"up"\|"down" = `"up"`; `seed?` int = `0`; `shape?` "circle"\|"square" = `"circle"`; `jitter?` number = `0.5` · variation of size and speed between particles; `twinkle?` number = `0.3` · how much each particle's opacity pulses
- **progress-bar**: A bar along the top or bottom edge that fills from 0 to 100% over duration frames.  
  `duration?` int = `300` · frames to go from empty to full (usually the clip length); `color?` string = `"#ffffff"`; `background?` string = `"rgba(255,255,255,0.25)"`; `height?` number = `12`; `position?` "top"\|"bottom" = `"bottom"`; `inset?` number = `0` · distance from the edge in px
- **counter**: A number that counts from `from` to `to` over duration frames (stats, prices; countdowns with easing=linear rounding=step).  
  `from?` number = `0`; `to?` number = `100`; `duration?` int = `60` · frames to reach `to`; it then holds; `decimals?` int = `0`; `prefix?` string = `""`; `suffix?` string = `""`; `separator?` string = `""` · thousands separator, e.g. ","; `easing?` easing = `"outCubic"` · keyframe easing names (linear, outCubic, outBack, inOutQuad, ...); `rounding?` "round"\|"floor"\|"ceil"\|"step" = `"round"` · round/floor/ceil the eased value; step = equal holds per value (countdowns: from=3 to=1 easing=linear rounding=step); `font?` string = `"Inter"` · a font family, or the id of a font asset; `weight?` int = `700`; `color?` string = `"#ffffff"`; `size?` number = `160` · font size in px
- **checker**: Checkerboard background (optionally rotated and scrolling).  
  `size?` number = `64` · cell size in px; `angle?` number = `0`; `speed?` number = `0` · scroll speed in px per second; `colors?` string[] = `["#1f1f1f","#2e2e2e"]`
- **pattern**: Repeating background pattern: checker, stripes, dots or grid, optionally rotated and scrolling.  
  `kind?` "checker"\|"stripes"\|"dots"\|"grid" = `"stripes"`; `size?` number = `64` · cell size in px; `angle?` number = `0`; `speed?` number = `0` · scroll speed in px per second; `colors?` string[] = `["#111111","#222222"]` · background colour, then pattern colour; `lineWidth?` number = `2` · grid line width in px
- **waveform**: Audiogram waveform: the loudness of an asset's sound around the current moment, as bars, mirrored bars or a line for podcast videos (gen.asset names the sound).  
  `asset` string · id of the audio (or video) asset whose sound to show; `color?` string = `"#ffffff"`; `smoothing?` number = `0.5` · 0 = jumpy, 1 = smooth (averages neighbouring frames); `gain?` number = `1` · scales the levels before drawing; `gap?` number = `0.3` · space between bars as a fraction of each bar slot; `width?` number = `0` · layer width in px (0 = 80% of the comp width); `height?` number = `0` · layer height in px (0 = 15% of the comp height); `style?` "bars"\|"mirror"\|"line" = `"mirror"` · bars grow up from the bottom, mirror from the middle, line is an envelope; `bars?` int = `48` · number of bars (or line points); `window?` number = `3` · seconds of sound shown across the width, centred on now; `thickness?` number = `4` · line width in px (style line)
- **spectrum**: Audio spectrum: bars for low → high frequencies of an asset's sound at the current frame for music visualisers (gen.asset names the sound).  
  `asset` string · id of the audio (or video) asset whose sound to show; `color?` string = `"#ffffff"`; `smoothing?` number = `0.5` · 0 = jumpy, 1 = smooth (averages neighbouring frames); `gain?` number = `1` · scales the levels before drawing; `gap?` number = `0.3` · space between bars as a fraction of each bar slot; `width?` number = `0` · layer width in px (0 = 80% of the comp width); `height?` number = `0` · layer height in px (0 = 15% of the comp height); `bands?` int = `32` · number of bars; `style?` "bars"\|"mirror" = `"bars"`
- **timecode**: Burned-in timecode (HH:MM:SS:FF from `start`, at the comp rate), a clock (HH:MM:SS), seconds or a frame number, on an optional box: review copies, BITC, news clocks.  
  `start?` string = `"00:00:00:00"` · timecode of the clip's first frame; `format?` "smpte"\|"clock"\|"seconds"\|"frames" = `"smpte"`; `drop?` boolean = `false` · drop-frame counting at 29.97 / 59.94; `prefix?` string = `""` · text before the time, e.g. "TC "; `font?` string = `"JetBrains Mono"` · a font family, or the id of a font asset; `weight?` int = `700`; `size?` number = `56` · font size in px; `color?` string = `"#ffffff"`; `bg?` string = `"rgba(0,0,0,0.6)"` · box colour ("transparent" for none); `padding?` number = `12` · box padding in px
- **smpte-bars**: Colour bars for a head leader: SMPTE (7 bars, castellations, -I/white/+Q and PLUGE) or EBU (8 full-height bars), at 75% or 100% (picture only: tone is an audio asset).  
  `standard?` "smpte"\|"ebu" = `"smpte"`; `level?` 75\|100 = `75` · bar amplitude in % of white
- **countdown-leader**: Film-style countdown leader: a big number per second from `from` down to 1 with a sweeping hand, circles and crosshair (make the clip `from` seconds long).  
  `from?` int = `5`; `color?` string = `"#ffffff"` · numbers and lines; `bg?` string = `"#202020"`; `sweep?` string = `"rgba(255,255,255,0.18)"` · colour of the sweeping hand's wedge; `font?` string = `"Inter"`

## Templates

`mgl edit video.mgl.json template.apply <id> at=1s params='{...}'` (see templates.md).

- **intro**: Title card: background, accent shapes, a popping title and a subtitle that slides up (4 s).  
  `title?` string = `"Your title here"`; `subtitle?` string = `""`; `bg?` string = `"#101014"`; `accent?` string = `"#ffd400"`
- **lower-third**: Name and role on a dark plate with an accent bar, bottom left; wipes in and out (5 s).  
  `name?` string = `"Jane Doe"`; `role?` string = `""`; `accent?` string = `"#ffd400"`; `plate?` string = `"#000000b3"`
- **cta**: Call-to-action button (rounded rect + label) that pops in and bounces, inside the safe zone (3 s).  
  `label?` string = `"Subscribe"`; `color?` string = `"#ff0033"`; `textColor?` string = `"#ffffff"`; `y?` number = `0.8` · vertical position inside the safe area, 0 = top, 1 = bottom
- **title**: A big centred title that pops in word by word and fades out (3 s).  
  `text?` string = `"Big title"`; `color?` string = `"#ffffff"`
- **end-card**: End screen: background, title, two video placeholders and a subtitle (5 s).  
  `title?` string = `"Thanks for watching"`; `subtitle?` string = `"Subscribe for more"`; `bg?` string = `"#101014"`; `accent?` string = `"#ffd400"`
- **progress-bar**: A bar that fills from left to right over the comp length (or len), at the top or bottom of the safe area.  
  `color?` string = `"#ffd400"`; `trackColor?` string = `"#ffffff33"`; `position?` "top"\|"bottom" = `"bottom"`; `thickness?` number = `12`
- **quote**: A quotation with a large accent quote mark and the author underneath (5 s).  
  `quote?` string = `"Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication."`; `author?` string = `""`; `accent?` string = `"#ffd400"`
- **listicle-item**: A numbered list item: a number in an accent circle and the item text (3 s).  
  `number?` int = `1`; `text?` string = `"List item"`; `accent?` string = `"#ffd400"`; `numberColor?` string = `"#111111"`
- **bars-and-tone**: Head-leader colour bars (SMPTE or EBU, from the smpte-bars generator) with an optional ident line (10 s). Picture only: add the 1 kHz tone as an audio asset (e.g. ffmpeg -f lavfi -i sine=f=1000:d=10 tone.wav) on an audio track.  
  `ident?` string = `""` · optional ident text over the bars, e.g. the programme title; `standard?` "smpte"\|"ebu" = `"smpte"`; `level?` 75\|100 = `75`
- **slate**: Programme slate: title, then version, date and duration lines on a dark card (5 s). Empty fields are left out.  
  `title?` string = `"Untitled"`; `version?` string = `"v1"`; `date?` string = `""`; `duration?` string = `""`; `client?` string = `""`; `bg?` string = `"#111111"`; `accent?` string = `"#ffd400"`
- **countdown**: Countdown leader: a number per second from `from` down to 1 with a sweeping hand (countdown-leader generator); the clip is `from` seconds long unless len is given.  
  `from?` int = `5`; `color?` string = `"#ffffff"`; `bg?` string = `"#202020"`
- **hook-title**: Scroll-stopping hook for the first seconds of a Short: an optional kicker pill, a heavy upper-case line that snaps in word by word and a tilted highlight sticker line in the accent colour, over a soft dark scrim (3 s). e.g. template.apply hook-title params='{"kicker": "Productivity", "text": "Stop doing this", "highlight": "every morning"}'  
  `text?` string = `"Stop scrolling if you"`; `highlight?` string = `"want more focus"` · second line on an accent sticker ("" for none); `kicker?` string = `""` · small label above the hook, e.g. "Part 1" or "3 tips"; `accent?` string = `"#ffe01b"`; `accentText?` string = `"#111111"` · text colour on the accent sticker; `position?` "top"\|"center" = `"top"` · top: upper third (leaves the middle for the subject); center: middle of the safe area; `scrim?` boolean = `true` · a soft dark gradient behind the text so it reads over busy footage
- **follow-outro**: Outro card: animated gradient background, avatar ring with your initial, @handle, a headline and a Subscribe / Follow button that a pointer clicks (it turns into Subscribed / Following with a ripple) (5 s). platform sets the label and colour (youtube, tiktok, instagram). e.g. template.apply follow-outro params='{"handle": "@studio.mia", "title": "Follow for daily tips", "platform": "tiktok"}'  
  `handle?` string = `"@yourchannel"`; `title?` string = `"Want more like this?"`; `platform?` "youtube"\|"tiktok"\|"instagram" = `"youtube"`; `label?` string = `""` · button text (default: Subscribe on youtube, Follow elsewhere); `doneLabel?` string = `""` · button text after the click (default: Subscribed / Following); `accent?` string · button colour (default: the platform colour); `bg?` string[] = `["#14102e","#3a1d6e","#0b0a1a"]` · background gradient colours; `click?` boolean = `true` · animate a pointer clicking the button

## Styles

Built-in text styles, usable as `"style": "<id>"` or as `base` of your own style.

- **title**: Big bold title: Anton 120, white with a black stroke; at most 3 lines (a long title shrinks instead of running off a narrow frame). `{"font":"Anton","size":120,"weight":"normal","color":"#ffffff","stroke":"#000000","strokeWidth":8,"align":"center","lineHeight":1.05,"maxLines":3}`
- **subtitle**: Secondary line under a title: Inter 56 semibold, soft shadow. `{"font":"Inter","size":56,"weight":600,"color":"#ffffff","shadow":"#00000099","shadowBlur":8,"shadowOffset":[0,3],"align":"center","lineHeight":1.2}`
- **caption**: Readable captions: Inter 64 bold, white with a black stroke, 800 px wide (inside the Shorts safe area when centred), 2 lines. `{"font":"Inter","size":64,"weight":"bold","color":"#ffffff","stroke":"#000000","strokeWidth":6,"maxWidth":800,"maxLines":2,"align":"center","lineHeight":1.15}`
- **karaoke**: Captions with the spoken word highlighted in yellow. `{"base":"caption","highlight":"#ffd400"}`
- **pop**: Loud punchy words: Inter Black 96, yellow with a black stroke, upper case. `{"font":"Inter","size":96,"weight":900,"color":"#ffd400","stroke":"#000000","strokeWidth":8,"uppercase":true,"align":"center","lineHeight":1.05}`
- **boxed**: Dark text on a white rounded box. `{"font":"Inter","size":56,"weight":"bold","color":"#111111","bg":"#ffffff","bgPadding":[28,14],"bgRadius":18,"align":"center"}`
- **lower-third**: Name line of a lower third: Inter 56 bold, left aligned, at most 2 lines (readable from 720p vertical to 4K). `{"font":"Inter","size":56,"weight":"bold","color":"#ffffff","align":"left","shadow":"#00000080","shadowBlur":6,"maxLines":2}`
- **cta**: Call-to-action label: Inter Black 56, white, upper case. `{"font":"Inter","size":56,"weight":900,"color":"#ffffff","uppercase":true,"align":"center","letterSpacing":1}`
- **label**: Small tag on a translucent dark box. `{"font":"Inter","size":36,"weight":"bold","color":"#ffffff","bg":"#000000b3","bgPadding":[16,8],"bgRadius":8,"align":"center"}`
- **hormozi**: Viral talking-head captions: Montserrat Black 92, upper case, white with a heavy black outline and drop shadow, 3 words at a time, the spoken word in yellow, *marked* keywords in green. e.g. captions.from-text text="This one habit changed everything" style=hormozi `{"font":"Montserrat","size":92,"weight":900,"color":"#ffffff","stroke":"#000000","strokeWidth":11,"shadow":"#000000b3","shadowBlur":16,"shadowOffset":[0,6],"uppercase":true,"highlight":"#ffe01b","emphasisColor":"#39e75f","maxWords":3,"maxWidth":800,"maxLines":2,"align":"center","lineHeight":1.08,"letterSpacing":-1}`
- **word-pop**: One word at a time, big and loud: Bebas Neue 168, white with a black outline and shadow (the spoken word is the only word shown). e.g. captions.from-text text="Wait for the ending" style=word-pop `{"font":"Bebas Neue","size":168,"weight":"normal","color":"#ffffff","stroke":"#000000","strokeWidth":10,"shadow":"#000000aa","shadowBlur":20,"shadowOffset":[0,8],"uppercase":true,"highlight":"#ffffff","maxWords":1,"maxWidth":800,"maxLines":1,"align":"center","lineHeight":1,"letterSpacing":2}`
- **body**: Body text: Inter 44 regular, relaxed line height. `{"font":"Inter","size":44,"weight":"normal","color":"#ffffff","lineHeight":1.35,"align":"center"}`

## Text animations

`text.animate <clip> in=<id> by=word` (char, word, line, all).

**none** (No animation (shown at rest).) · **fade** (Fade in.) · **pop** (Scale 0.6 → 1.08 → 1 with a quick fade: a punchy overshoot.) · **slide-up** (Rise 40 px into place while fading in.) · **slide-down** (Drop 40 px into place while fading in.) · **slide-left** (Slide in 60 px from the right while fading in.) · **typewriter** (Each unit appears at once (use by: "char").) · **blur-in** (Sharpen from a 12 px blur while fading in.) · **bounce** (Fall 60 px and bounce to rest.) · **scale-in** (Grow from 0 to full size while fading in.) · **drop** (Drop 80 px from above with a slight overshoot.) · **wave** (Each unit hops up 24 px and lands (stagger makes a wave).) · **snap** (Punch in from 1.6× to 1 with a small 0.96 undershoot and a fast fade: words land like hits (best with by: "word"). e.g. text.animate title in=snap by=word stagger=4)
